frame: legacy-v06 (same glyph-local frame as A/B/G/R/S and wave 1, y down)

provenance.author: Claude (AI), NIGHTSHIFT implementation session
provenance.roadmap: C02 Wave 2 (contracts/alphabet-authoring-plan.v1.json: bar and stem systems E, F, H, I, L, T)
provenance.method: Original hand-authored line contours normalised to the family metrics of the authored masters: spine/stem 26 units (as B, D, P, R), bar thickness 23, cap height 8–132, shared middle-bar band 59–81 for E, F and H, top bar 8–31 for E, F, T. Straight construction without decoration; letterform grammars come later (C03). Not traced or derived from any font, artwork, photograph or identifiable writer.

notes: Never edit by hand without bumping version; geometry changes after import go through editor commands.
The legacy v0.6 provisional base of each glyph is kept as a reference-only second variant.
Compared with the v0.6 bases, the masters unify stem width (v0.6: 27–28) and bar thickness (v0.6: 25–27) with the authored family.

E.brief: Spine with three bars: top and foot bars to full width, middle bar shorter and at the optical centre; no enclosed counter (distinction from B).

F.brief: Spine with top bar and the same shortened middle bar as E; open foot (distinction from E by the missing foot bar).

H.brief: Two full-height stems joined by one crossbar at the same height as the E/F middle bar; two open notches above and below (no counter).

I.brief: Single stem with terminal bars at cap height and baseline, so I keeps a readable width in words; stem centred.

L.brief: Spine with a foot bar to the right; open upper right (distinction from E/F by bar position).

T.brief: Full-width top bar with a centred stem; stem width equal to the family spine.
